cases.name: Michelle Abdill
cases.about: She owned a property management company.
cases.narrative:
Authorities said he lured Ellis and Abdill to a Medford, Oregon, duplex apartment, where he bound, gagged and blindfolded them with duct tape, and shot them twice in the head with a pistol.
Their bodies were discovered three days later in a truck, which was parked near the apartment.
